name: tuskledger
description: Local-first personal finance app: Plaid bank sync into a SQLite file on your laptop, FastAPI + React UI, optional local Ollama for AI Insights and the in-app Ask panel. This Cowork plugin bundles the tuskledger-mcp server (so your AI assistant gets typed access to your data via 23 tools — 20 read + 3 write) plus slash commands for guided install and environment health checks.
